title: BMA session file (bma sessions launch -f)
description: A session to start in one step: the agent, where it runs, what is mounted and the first message. Names are resolved to IDs from the lists; a name must match exactly one item.

agent.description: The agent: its name or aprf_ ID (its latest version); {id or name, version} to pin a version; or an inline definition (with model, see agent.schema.json), created or updated like `bma agents apply`.

environment.description: An environment's name or env_ ID, or a machine's mch_ ID (a granted machine is listed as an environment).

machine_pool.description: A machine pool's name or ID: mpo_ (a machine of the pool is started for the session) or env_ (a cloud environment's own pool).

metadata.description: Stored with the session; bma adds bma_cli_launch_key.

oneOf.description: A local file, uploaded and attached to the session. mount_path is its path in the session's uploads directory (default: <file_id>); the session shows the real path, /mnt/session/<session_id>/uploads/<path>. Relative paths start at the session file's directory.
A memory store, by memstore_ ID or name.

message.description: The first user message (--message replaces it).

files.description: Attachments of the first message: uploaded, attached at <name> in the session's uploads directory and listed in the message with the path the session shows for it (--file adds more).
